plans.rationale: Early round (0/60 budget used). Only 3 cells occupied in a 10x10 grid (3% coverage), clustered at [3,4], [4,4], [4,5]. Best voltage 3.827 at [3,4]. Targeting 6 empty cells adjacent to occupied ones to expand coverage locally, reduce duplicate risk, and explore voltage-energy trade-offs near the best performer. Weights favor strain (0.4) for structured perturbations of good seeds, with rattle (0.3) and permute (0.3) for diversity. Substitute not yet allowed.

Round 1: 4 cells occupied (4% coverage), clustered at [3,4], [4,4], [4,5], [5,4]. Best voltage 4.114 at [5,4] from strain. Strain produced 2 duplicates (wasting budget) and 1 dominated; permute gave 1 accepted, 1 dominated; rattle untried. Shift weight from strain (0.25) to rattle (0.4) for diversity, keep permute (0.35) for cation swaps. Target 8 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster to expand coverage locally and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 2: 4 cells occupied (4% coverage), clustered at [3,4], [4,4], [4,5], [5,4]. Best voltage 4.205 at [5,4] from permute (Mn/Co swap). Strain produced 2 duplicates and 1 dominated in recent results; permute gave 3 accepted (including best voltage) but also 3 duplicates/dominated; rattle untried despite 0.4 weight in round 1. Duplicates waste budget (4/17 evaluations). Shift weight from strain (0.2) to rattle (0.45) for structural diversity, keep permute (0.35) for productive cation swaps. Target 8 empty cells adjacent to the occupied cluster to expand coverage locally and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 3: Coverage only 6% (6/100 cells), duplicate rate ~30% (7/23 evaluations). Best voltage 4.205 at [5,4] from permute (Mn/Co swap). Permute productive for voltage but generates duplicates; strain produces duplicates; rattle underutilized despite 0.45 weight (only 1 accepted in recent). Shift weight to rattle (0.5) for structural diversity in fresh cells, reduce strain (0.15), keep permute (0.35) for cation optimization. Target 16 empty cells adjacent to the occupied cluster ([3,4], [4,4], [4,5], [5,4], [5,5], [6,5]) to expand coverage locally and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 4: Coverage 7% (7/100 cells), duplicate rate ~34% (10/29 evaluations). Best voltage 4.205 at [5,4] from permute (Mn/Co swap). Strain produces mostly duplicates (5/6 recent rejected); rattle gives structural diversity (1 accepted, 1 duplicate); permute productive for voltage but duplicate-prone. Reduce strain to 0.1, increase rattle to 0.6 for diversity in fresh cells, keep permute at 0.3 for cation optimization. Target 10 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster, prioritizing neighbors of high-voltage cells [5,4] (4.205), [6,5] (3.866), [4,4] (3.863) to expand coverage locally and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 5: Coverage 8% (8/100 cells), duplicate rate ~34% (12/35 evaluations). Best voltage 4.216 at [6,4] from strain (symmetric strain, max |e| = 0.100). Strain found best voltage but produces duplicates; rattle underutilized (1 recent attempt, rejected as duplicate); permute productive for voltage but duplicate-prone. Increase rattle to 0.5 for structural diversity in fresh cells, keep strain at 0.2 since it found the global best voltage, keep permute at 0.3 for cation optimization. Target 12 empty cells adjacent to the occupied cluster ([3-6,3-5]), prioritizing neighbors of high-voltage cells [6,4] (4.216), [5,4] (4.205), [6,5] (3.956) to expand coverage locally and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 6: Coverage 9% (9/100 cells), duplicate rate ~39% (16/41 evaluations). Best voltage 4.216 at [6,4] from strain (symmetric strain, max |e| = 0.100). Strain finds high voltage but produces many duplicates (5/6 recent strain attempts rejected as duplicates); rattle gives structural diversity (1 accepted at [7,5]); permute productive for voltage but duplicate-prone (3/6 recent permute rejected as duplicates, 2 dominated). Reduce strain to 0.15 (keep some since it found global best), increase rattle to 0.55 for diversity in fresh cells, keep permute at 0.3 for cation optimization. Target 12 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster ([3-7,3-5]), prioritizing neighbors of high-voltage cells [6,4] (4.216), [5,4] (4.205), [6,5] (3.956) and expanding outward to [8,4], [8,5] to increase coverage and reduce duplicate risk in fresh territory.

Round 7: Coverage 9% (9/100 cells), duplicate rate ~42% (20/47 evaluations). Best voltage 4.216 at [6,4]. Strain produced 0/3 accepted (all duplicates); rattle 1/1 accepted (structural diversity in fresh cell [7,5]); permute 2/7 accepted but 4 duplicates + 1 dominated. Strain is exhausted as a diversity source—reduce to 0.1 (minimal). Rattle is the only operator consistently finding novel structures—increase to 0.6. Permute kept at 0.3 for cation optimization in occupied cells. Target 12 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster ([3-7,3-5]), prioritizing neighbors of high-voltage cells: [6,4] (4.216)→[7,4],[6,3],[6,6]; [5,4] (4.205)→[5,3],[4,3]; [6,5] (3.956)→[6,6]; plus outward expansion [7,3],[3,5],[4,6],[5,6],[7,6],[8,4],[8,5] to increase coverage in fresh territory and reduce duplicate risk.

Round 8: Coverage 9% (9/100 cells), duplicate rate ~47% (25/53 evaluations). Best voltage 4.216 at [6,4]. Strain exhausted (0/3 accepted in R7, all duplicates); rattle only operator consistently finding novel structures (1/1 accepted in R7, structural diversity in fresh cell [7,5]); permute productive for voltage but duplicate-prone (2/7 accepted in R7, 4 duplicates + 1 dominated). Budget: 7 evaluations left (60-53). Strategy: maximize rattle (0.7) in fresh cells adjacent to high-voltage cluster to gain coverage and novel structures; minimal strain (0.05) as backup; permute (0.25) for cation optimization. Target 12 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster [3-7,3-5], prioritizing neighbors of highest-voltage cells: [6,4] (4.216)→[7,4],[6,3],[5,3]; [5,4] (4.205)→[5,3],[4,3]; [6,5] (3.956)→[6,6]; [7,5] (3.922)→[7,6],[8,4],[8,5]; plus [3,5],[4,6],[5,6],[7,3] for outward expansion and coverage.

Final round (1 evaluation left of 60 budget). Round 9 used 11 evaluations (59 total), mostly permute, yielding 3 accepted but all in already-occupied cells and high duplicate rate. Rattle is the only operator that consistently produces novel structures in fresh cells (Round 7: 1/1 accepted in new cell [7,5]; Round 8: targeted but results not shown). Strain is exhausted (0 accepted in Rounds 7-9). Permute optimizes cations but stays in occupied cells and duplicates heavily. Best voltage 4.216 at [6,4]; its empty neighbor [7,4] is the highest-priority fresh cell. Put full weight on rattle (1.0) to maximize chance of a novel structure in this last evaluation.
